Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Description: pushes the Session Notes half of the dashboard into the Client web viewer.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Context: a window with the "web" web viewer (Client - wv). Called by Manage: Client (loadDashboard) and by Manage: Document (close), so the list is current after a note is closed. DO NOT give this script full access. It relies on record-level access: interventionists see their own notes, supervisors their team's, admins everything.

Value.Calculation: Let ( ~d = Get ( CurrentDate ) - 30 ; Year ( ~d ) & "-" & Right ( "0" & Month ( ~d ) ; 2 ) & "-" & Right ( "0" & Day ( ~d ) ; 2 ) )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Recent = session date in the last 30 days, plus anything not yet locked however old. sessionDate is stored as YYYY-MM-DD text, so a string comparison is a date comparison and uses the index.

Value.Calculation: ExecuteSQL ( "SELECT \"asJSONDashboardArray\" FROM \"SessionNote\" WHERE \"sessionDate\" >= ? OR \"status\" IS NULL OR \"status\" NOT IN ('Final','Void') ORDER BY \"sessionDate\" DESC" ; "" ; "," ; $cutoff )
ExecuteSQL ( "SELECT \"asJSONDashboardArray\" FROM \"SessionNote\" WHERE \"awaitingSupervisor\" = 1 AND \"supervisorUserId\" = ? ORDER BY \"sessionDate\" DESC" ; "" ; "," ; $myId )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ExecuteSQL returns ? on an error - never hand that to JSON.

Value.Calculation: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; ["notes" ; "[" & If ( Left ( $notes ; 1 ) = "?" ; "" ; $notes ) & "]" ; JSONArray] ; ["queue" ; "[" & If ( Left ( $queue ; 1 ) = "?" or IsEmpty ( $myId ) ; "" ; $queue ) & "]" ; JSONArray] ; ["cutoff" ; $cutoff ; JSONString] ; ["sqlError" ; Left ( $notes ; 1 ) = "?" ; JSONBoolean] ; ["me.id" ; $myId ; JSONString] ; ["me.isSupervisor" ; PatternCount ( $roles ; "Supervisor" ) > 0 ; JSONBoolean] ; ["me.isAdmin" ; PatternCount ( $roles ; "\"Admin\"" ) > 0 or Get ( AccountPrivilegeSetName ) = "[Full Access]" or Get ( AccountPrivilegeSetName ) = "Admin" ; JSONBoolean] )
